title: Why biological data matters more in AI drug discovery
summary: GSK has partnered with Relation Therapeutics in a $110 million collaboration to generate large-scale biological datasets measuring human cell responses to genetic changes and drug interventions, which will be used to train AI models for drug discovery.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of comprehensive biological data needed to effectively train AI models for predicting drug efficacy and cellular responses.
why_valuable: High-quality biological data can significantly improve AI model accuracy in drug discovery, potentially reducing development time and costs while increasing success rates.
